name: Gatus

lifecycle.note: Pinned v5.37.0 shared recipe has a generated self-check configuration and a no-account private readiness adapter. Monitoring other services and alerts are not configured.

security: Keep the unauthenticated dashboard and status API on loopback or a separately approved private route.
Review target URLs and alert credentials before adding real monitors; neither is in the starter recipe.
pitfalls: The starter configuration checks only Gatus itself; readiness is not evidence of monitoring other services.
Default in-memory history does not survive restart; the recipe selects SQLite on a project-owned volume.
No administrator account or API key is generated by this recipe.
